title: Security Assessment & Design
metaDescription: Foundational security assessment methodology for nuclear and critical infrastructure: outside-in for existing facilities, inside-out for new build.
heroDek: Every technology purchase and staffing decision downstream of a protective strategy is only as sound as the assessment it was built on. GSS establishes requirements first, in the direction the facility actually calls for.
contextHeading: Every protective strategy starts with a direction of travel
contextParagraphs: For an existing facility, the assessment runs outside-in: it starts at the perimeter and moves inward the way an adversary would, evaluating detection, delay, and response as they are actually encountered rather than as they appear on a drawing.

For a facility still in design, the direction reverses. There is no perimeter to walk yet, so the assessment runs inside-out, starting from the vital areas and target sets that must be protected and working outward to size everything else — barriers, detection, response — to that requirement rather than retrofitting it later.
Both directions produce the same thing: a documented basis for what the site actually needs, established before a single sensor, barrier, or additional post is specified.

methodology.label: Requirements Definition
methodology.body: Protection objectives established against Design Basis Threat capability and consequence criteria before any design decision is made.

methodology.label: Outside-In Assessment
methodology.body: For existing facilities: analysis begins at the perimeter and works inward, evaluating detection, delay, and response as an adversary would encounter them.

methodology.label: Inside-Out Design
methodology.body: For new build: analysis begins at the vital areas and target sets and works outward, sizing protective layers to what they must protect.

methodology.label: Gap Analysis
methodology.body: Measured performance compared against the protective strategy's actual requirements, not against assumption.

methodology.label: Design Basis Documentation
methodology.body: Findings translated into a defensible basis for investment, staffing, and licensing decisions.

faq.q: Do you assess existing facilities and new build programs the same way?
faq.a: No. The direction of travel reverses — outside-in for an existing perimeter, inside-out from vital areas and target sets when there is no facility yet to walk.

faq.q: How long does a full assessment take?
faq.a: It scales with facility size and how much prior analysis already exists; scope is set at kickoff rather than assumed from a standard package.

faq.q: Does this replace our existing security plan?
faq.a: No — it measures the existing plan against requirement and identifies where it needs to change, which is usually more useful than starting over.
